scope: Visual-only comparison of the final Sync 2 Pro captioned contact sheet against the native R7 contact sheet, concentrating on the eight labeled opening samples.

observations.observation: Restoration changes the native closed mouths at 3.875 and 4.250 to open speaking shapes. The lips meet at 4.500 while the smiling eyes and raised cheeks remain visible.

The warm cheek and eye expression remains after restoration. At 5.667 the mouth is rounded and nearly closed; at 6.125 it is open. These differ visibly from the native speaking shapes without an obvious gross mouth-edge seam or facial distortion in these samples.

continuity: The sampled eyes, brows, cheeks, glasses, hair and home setting remain consistent with the native opening. The wider final examples retain the olive overshirt and off-white shirt.
direction_assessment: Restoration preserves the smile and eye warmth while changing articulation. The requested full neutral settle by 5.250 is still not established: warmth persists into the sampled With AI interval.
mouth_shape_assessment: Closure at 4.500, rounding at 5.667 and an open mouth at 6.125 are plausible speech shapes near the supplied better / With / AI timing cues. This is a visual plausibility observation, not evidence of accurate synchronization.
limits: No audio was heard and no normal-speed playback was assessed for this comparison.
Sparse stills and approximate word timing cannot establish phoneme alignment, continuous naturalness, or a perceptual improvement over prior revisions.
Caption text was not used as synchronization evidence.
approval_status: No owner acceptance or production-gate change.
